# wso2is_user_share (Resource)

Shares a user of the root organization with sub-organizations (WSO2 IS 7.3 and later). The user can also get roles in those organizations. The same account can then sign in to the organizations' applications. The resource manages all shares of the user. The server applies changes in the background, and the provider waits until they are visible. To import, use the user ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_organization" "partner" {
  name = "Partner Inc"
}

# An application shared with the organization, with an application role.
resource "wso2is_application" "portal" {
  name = "Partner Portal"
  associated_roles = {
    allowed_audience = "APPLICATION"
  }
  oidc = {
    grant_types   = ["authorization_code"]
    callback_urls = ["https://portal.example.com/callback"]
  }
}

resource "wso2is_role" "support_agent" {
  name          = "support-agent"
  audience_type = "application"
  audience_id   = wso2is_application.portal.id
}

resource "wso2is_application_share" "portal" {
  application_id   = wso2is_application.portal.id
  organization_ids = [wso2is_organization.partner.id]
  depends_on       = [wso2is_role.support_agent]
}

# A support engineer of the root organization who works in the partner's organization.
resource "wso2is_user" "support" {
  username = "sam"
  email    = "sam@example.com"
  password = var.sam_password
}

resource "wso2is_user_share" "support" {
  user_id = wso2is_user.support.id
  organizations = [{
    organization_id  = wso2is_organization.partner.id
    include_children = true
    roles = [{
      name          = wso2is_role.support_agent.name
      audience_type = "application"
      audience_name = wso2is_application.portal.name
    }]
  }]
  # Application roles reach the organization when the application is shared.
  depends_on = [wso2is_application_share.portal]
}

variable "sam_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) ID of a user of the root organization.

### Optional

- `organizations` (Attributes Set) Organizations to share the user with. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--organizations))
- `share_with_all` (Attributes) Share with every current and future organization. Conflicts with `organizations`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--share_with_all))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `user_id`.

<a id="nestedatt--organizations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `organizations`

Required:

- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID.

Optional:

- `include_children` (Boolean) Also share with the organization's current and future child organizations. `false` when omitted.
- `roles` (Attributes Set) Roles the shared user gets in the organization(s). None when omitted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--organizations--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--organizations--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `organizations.roles`

Required:

- `audience_name` (String) Name of the application, or of the organization for organization roles.
- `audience_type` (String) `application` for a role of a shared application, `organization` for an organization role.
- `name` (String) Role name.



<a id="nestedatt--share_with_all"></a>
### Nested Schema for `share_with_all`

Optional:

- `roles` (Attributes Set) Roles the shared user gets in the organization(s). None when omitted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--share_with_all--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--share_with_all--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `share_with_all.roles`

Required:

- `audience_name` (String) Name of the application, or of the organization for organization roles.
- `audience_type` (String) `application` for a role of a shared application, `organization` for an organization role.
- `name` (String) Role name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_user_share.support <user_id>
```
